answer: Decay runs at 12 percent per idle epoch and hits zero after eight. Duplicate detection hashes the payload, so a copied answer forfeits the whole stake instead of scoring low. Eight epochs to zero, one duplicate to lose the stake, zero recoveries from a burned identity. The failure mode is a farm that pays for registration, copies one pearl of an answer across 100 keys, and loses all 100 stakes to the same hash. A beacon lit over 100 cheap keys is not a bridge to standing.
